answer.new_information: Corning's CEO says the company is in its fastest growth period and will probably double its size over the coming years, with almost all new hires in advanced manufacturing and a significant part in the US. This is forward-looking, has no stated period, and does not define 'size' (revenue, headcount, or capacity), so it cannot be mapped to any NVDA question. The Corning-NVIDIA facilities, 3,000 jobs and tenfold capacity figures in the same article are Fox reporting with no completion date, and they are not restated by Weeks here.
